newsitem.title: FRANCE: SIDO raises target for French sunflower imports.
newsitem.headline: SIDO raises target for French sunflower imports.

text.p: French oilseeds and protein seeds association SIDO raised its estimate for imports of sunflower into France in 1996/97 to 465,000 tonnes from a January target of 450,000 tonnes and 213,000 tonnes imported in 1995/96.
In its March report SIDO also raised its forecast for French rapeseed exports to 580,000 tonnes from a previous target of 520,000 tonnes and 517,000 tonnes exported in 1995/96.
It kept its crushings estimate unchanged at 1.6 million tonnes. But it raised its forecast for use of sunflower in animal feed to 65,000 tonnes from 40,000 tonnes, citing attractive prices.
SIDO kept its estimate for the 1996 sunflower crop unchanged from January at two million tonnes. This would represent a five percent rise over 1995.
It cut the estimate for carryover stocks to 416,000 tonnes from a previous forecast of 466,000 tonnes. This would compare with a carryover of 256,000 tonnes at end June 1996.
